images.title: Kakadu (AU), Kakadu National Park, Yellow Water -- 2019 -- 3969
images.source_title: File:Kakadu (AU), Kakadu National Park, Yellow Water -- 2019 -- 3969.jpg
images.description: Attacking crocodile at Ngurrungurrudjba (Yellow Water) in Kakadu National Park, Northern Territory, Australia, As early as the 1930s, local communities and authorities were campaigning for environmental protection in the Northern Territory. In 1956, the park was officially protected under the name Kakadu. In the 1960s, further areas within the current park boundaries were added. In 1979, Kakadu was granted national park status, placing it under stricter protection. In the 1980s, more intensive coordination efforts began between Aboriginal communities, park management, and scientists, including programs to preserve landscapes, animal species, and cultural sites. In 1991, Kakadu was recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site along with Uluru-Kata Tjuta, which strengthened its international protection.

images.description: Blue-tailed Bee-eater (Merops philippinus) — a small, vibrant bird commonly found in open woodlands, agricultural fields, and around sparsely populated human settlements. It is characterised by a bluish throat, a narrow black eye stripe and throat band, rufous or rusty crown, and elongated central tail feathers. It displays graceful flight when catching insects mid-air., Location: Arakul, nestled within the vibrant Keraniganj area of the Narayanganj district, Bangladesh.

images.title: হুদহুদ (Eurasian Hoopoe)
images.description: হুদহুদ (Eurasian Hoopoe) একটি আকর্ষণীয় ও সহজে শনাক্তযোগ্য পাখি, যার বৈজ্ঞানিক নাম Upupa epops। এটি মাথায় মুকুটের মতো পালক, কমলা-বাদামি দেহ ও কালো-সাদা ডোরাকাটা পাখার জন্য পরিচিত। হুদহুদ মাটিতে হাঁটে এবং ঠোঁট দিয়ে পোকামাকড় খুঁড়ে খায়। এর ডাক “হুপ-হুপ” শব্দের মতো শোনা যায়। পাখিটি গ্রামাঞ্চল, মাঠ ও বাগানে দেখা যায় এবং বাংলাদেশে মাঝে মাঝে পরিযায়ী পাখি হিসেবে আসে। ইসলামী সংস্কৃতিতে এর গুরুত্ব রয়েছে, কারণ কুরআনে হজরত সোলাইমান (আ.)-এর দূত হিসেবে হুদহুদ পাখির উল্লেখ আছে।

images.title: Funchal (Madeira, Portugal), Rua de Santa Maria 58 -- 2025 -- 0835
images.source_title: File:Funchal (Madeira, Portugal), Rua de Santa Maria 58 -- 2025 -- 0835.jpg
images.description: Artistically designed front door “Rua de Santa Maria 58” (João Daniel Pestana, The arT of oPEn doORs), Funchal, Madeira, Portugal, The project “artE das pORtas Abertas” in Rua de Santa Maria and its side streets in Funchal is an art project by various artists that aims to open doors to art and culture. These art interventions take into account all visual arts, from painting and photography to writing., The project was initiated by artist José Maria Montero Zyberchema and former Regional Secretary for Tourism and Culture João Carlos Abreu. The first door to undergo an intervention was number 207 on Rua de Carreira in Funchal by Martinho Mendes on August 20, 2010. The first door in Rua Santa Maria was painted on April 6, 2011, by artist Mark Milewski at number 77, which took him more than a month to complete. However, the first artistic intervention was started and completed by Gonçalo Martins in Rua Santa Maria nos. 81 to 83 on April 9, 2011.
